AAPL.structural_diagnosis: 7 segments, 1 zhongshu (unsettled, no break) -> 0 moves -> recursive stack idle. AAPL 25-year daily: L1 structure incomplete (zhongshu not broken).

MSFT.structural_diagnosis: Only 2 segments, 0 zhongshus -> 0 moves. MSFT daily: L1 segment engine bottleneck (593 strokes compressed into 2 segments — likely one mega-trend).

GOOGL.structural_diagnosis: 9 segments, 2 zhongshus (1 settled, 1 unsettled), 1 unsettled consolidation move -> moves < 3 -> recursive termination. Best case among 3 symbols but still insufficient for L2.

AAPL_daily_vs_1min.T7: 0 vs 1 (regression — daily AAPL has fewer BSP than 1min AAPL)

MSFT_daily.note: Worst case — 593 strokes form only 2 segments

GOOGL_daily.T7: 1 (type3 buy — same order of magnitude as 229 baseline)

root_cause_diagnosis.finding: Recursive depth = 1 is a STRUCTURAL CONSTRAINT, not a data-insufficiency artifact.
root_cause_diagnosis.mechanism: RecursiveStack terminates when L1 moves < 3. All 3 symbols have L1 moves <= 1 even with 5000-6600 daily bars (20+ years).
bottleneck_chain: L1 strokes (400-600) -> L1 segments (2-9): segment engine compresses hundreds of strokes into few segments
L1 segments (2-9) -> L1 zhongshus (0-2): few segments produce few or no zhongshus
L1 zhongshus (0-2) -> L1 moves (0-1): zhongshu not broken or insufficient for move construction
L1 moves (0-1) -> recursive termination: moves < 3 triggers termination
root_cause_diagnosis.key_insight: The L1 segment engine is the primary bottleneck. With daily bars as input, each L1 segment spans massive time periods (e.g., GOOGL Seg[1] spans 3540 bars = ~14 years of daily data). The characteristic sequence method produces very few segments at this timescale.
root_cause_diagnosis.229_hypothesis_update: 229 hypothesized that 'longer timeframe or higher TF data would increase recursive depth'. This is FALSIFIED — daily x 20yr produces the SAME recursive depth as 1min x 5day.

downstream_implications.for_T6: T6 (nested divergence) requires recursive_levels >= 2 to form cross-level divergence chains. With the current pipeline producing recursive_levels = 1 on all tested data, T6 is structurally unreachable.
downstream_implications.for_T7: T7 (BSP) is marginally functional (0-1 BSP across 3 symbols with 20+ years of daily data). The low count is consistent with low zhongshu/move counts at L1.
downstream_implications.architectural_question: Is the bottleneck in the segment engine (correct behavior for daily data) or in the recursive architecture (should use multi-timeframe input rather than single-TF recursion)?

conclusion: 229号的'数据不足'假说被证伪：日线全量（20+年，5000-6600 bar）的递归深度与1分钟×5天完全相同（均为1级）。瓶颈是结构性的——L1线段引擎将数百根笔压缩为2-9根线段，导致中枢和走势数量不足以驱动递归。T6在当前架构下结构性不可达（需要recursive_levels>=2但从未实现）。T7边际可用但产出极低（3个标的20+年共1个买卖点）。
